name: Glint
description: Bend one lamp's light through mirrors, prisms and lenses and burn back the Shades. Twelve nights, alone or with three friends.

controls.action: Place, select, or tap a cell
Move glass, aim the Lamp, turn the dial
Begin the night or the next wave

badges.name: Rainbow
badges.description: Burn Shades with red, green and blue light in one night.

badges.name: Focus Point
badges.description: Burn a Shade with a focused beam in under a second.

badges.name: Mirror Maze
badges.description: Burn a Shade with a beam that bounced ten times.

badges.name: Heat Wave
badges.description: Crack a piece of glass and still see the dawn.

badges.name: Lens-Eater Down
badges.description: Burn the Lens-Eater's eye for good.

badges.name: Twin Hearts
badges.description: Finish a run on the Twin Hearts board.

badges.name: Ascendant
badges.description: Finish a run at Longer Dusk 4 or higher.
